description: Zero SMP 1.9.1 performance: ModernFix dynamic resources on (models are baked when first used instead of all at startup and on every F3+T; overrides the explicit false of 1.1.1). Distant Horizons renderer on, tuned for low cost: LOD radius 64 chunks (the owner's value), 2 DH threads at half run time and below-normal priority, surface-only distant generation in singleplayer (no feature/structure generation next to the integrated server; the Zero SMP server runs no DH, so multiplayer LODs only come from chunks the client receives anyway), low horizontal quality, biome blending 1, single-pass vanilla fade, no DH SSAO, flat-colour LODs (no textured LODs) and no LOD rebuilds when zooming. Client config only: the server needs nothing. DistantHorizons.toml keys name their [table]; _version = 5 keeps DH 3.3.3 from resetting an older (version 4) file to its defaults, which would drop these values (v4 and v5 only add/remove keys).
